digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Thursday closed with the Core Skills reconciliation documented and clear priority direction for Sprint 21, while the main carry-forward work remains concentrated on compliance remediation, Amazon Connect, and the MHE expansion.

items.detail: Today's SCV update reports that the job-role-based reconciliation was completed and 56 missing assignments were identified and documented with their Skill IDs and required readiness level.

items.label: Lock the compliance-remediation scope for Sprint 21
items.detail: Turn today's priority direction into a ranked, capacity-aware story list for Preparer's Certification, Declarations, and G-28 changes. Confirm what will be ready for Monday and resolve the remaining tradeoffs in Friday's follow-up.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect test and Waves 2/3 deployment gate
items.detail: Eduardo and Hilary were expected to update the team after today's Lambda adjustments and testing. Jean still needs to schedule the deployment-plan check-in and define the evidence required to resume final testing.

items.detail: Confirm whether all Florida and Texas clients are being identified beyond the RFE-stage screen, secure the written Legal position on post-filing RFE evidence, and name an IT owner after Friday's scoping.

items.label: Resolve the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: Rippling again lists the Dominican Republic EOR course as overdue. Complete it or confirm with HR why the assignment remains open.

items.label: Review Astrid Ortega's project-access requests

items.label: Decide David Molano's file-access request
items.detail: Approve or decline access to 'SKILL (2) 2.md' after confirming the file's purpose and the permission level David needs.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp Module 3 follow-up survey
items.detail: A reminder arrived today for the Leading with a Growth Mindset follow-up survey so the training team can capture how the concepts are being applied.

items.label: Operations Portfolio Review was canceled
items.detail: The noon review was canceled after alignment with Jill; pending initiatives will return in the next scheduled session, with time-sensitive decisions handled separately if needed.

items.detail: The 11:00 AM alignment will cover queue scope, phone numbers, users, call volumes, sequencing, target dates, and deployment dependencies. The competing Salesforce program sync was canceled.
